item.title: Getting started with quietfolio
item.description: quietfolio is a minimal developer portfolio template. It is a static Next.js site with a home page, case studies and a blog. This post is sample content that doubles as a setup guide.

item.title: How the SEO and AEO setup works
item.description: Search engines and AI answer engines both read the same signals: clean HTML, accurate metadata and structured data. quietfolio ships all of them by default.

item.title: Deploying to GitHub Pages or Netlify
item.description: quietfolio works on any host. There are two common setups.
